name: Biology PhD
detailsNote: Published fall dates and stipend are undated; Fall2027 is not explicitly confirmed. Admission arrangements differ by track; no uniform model assigned. Waiver instructions contain conflicting dates.

publishedDeadlines.label: Fall fee-waiver request, earlier published date
publishedDeadlines.note: Deadlines section says November1; waiver section says November16 and notification by January6, after the application deadline. Confirm the process before relying on a waiver.

applicationFee.note: International fee; domestic50USD. Competitive departmental fall-only waiver requires a pending application containing statement and transcript plus request form. No nationality restriction stated; international approval must be confirmed. November1/16 request dates and January6 notification conflict with December1 application deadline; confirm before relying on waiver.

english.note: IELTS Academic. Tests valid/reportable at submission, normally two years. Exemptions require qualifying US degree, English-instruction degree in a recognized English-speaking country, or UH intensive-English Level6. English-medium education in other countries is not a general exemption. Teaching appointments require published old TOEFL Speaking25, IELTS Speaking7.5, or DET conversation120/production105; confirm current test-format equivalents. Central PTE53 also accepted.

documents: Scanned official transcripts for review; final official degree records before enrollment
Statement of purpose/personal statement addressing preparation, interests, goals and relevant personal experiences
Three to four recommendation letters, usually professors who know the applicant well
requirements.note: BS in Biology/Biochemistry/equivalent completed before entry; MS not required. GPA at least3.0 overall or last60 hours. Faculty contact permitted before or after applying. CMB track requires at least two first-year lab rotations before adviser selection, with exceptions by petition; do not assume this applies to Ecology and Evolution. International final records must be institutional sealed/stamped paper records or approved attested copies; international electronic records not accepted.

funding.note: Department says all admitted graduate students receive stipend and Graduate Tuition Fellowship. Undated rate:2386USD/month or28632USD/year via TA/RA; tuition and mandatory fees covered subject to eligibility. International TA/RA appointments receive nonresident tuition waiver and funds toward health insurance. Competitive Presidential supplement2000USD/year for first two years requires full-time9credits and GPA3.0; no universal supplement or funding-duration guarantee.
